errors.evidence: The chart is a horizontal bar chart, not a vertical one, as the bars extend horizontally.

The chart does not specify the units of the values. Interpreting them as the "number of employed persons" is an assumption not supported by the visual information. The title refers to a "ranking" and "vulnerability", not a direct count.
The categories representing educational status are on the vertical axis, not the horizontal axis.
The numerical scale corresponds to the length of the bars along the horizontal dimension, not the vertical axis.

errors.text_span: етикетирана с числа, които са разположени на равномерни интервали
errors.evidence: The chart does not have a formal numerical axis with labels at regular intervals. The numbers shown are data labels for each bar.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете са подредени в низходящ ред
errors.evidence: The bars are sorted in ascending order from top to bottom, not descending. The top bar has the lowest value (1,271) and the bottom bar has the highest (6,415).

errors.text_span: визуална прогресия във височината на стълбовете
